scope: TaskRunStore schema migration, Event protocol versioning and recovery evidence
migrationContract: A versionless v1 store is decoded without losing Task, WorkItem, Run, Event or Association fields that it contains.
Before the first upgraded write, the exact legacy bytes are installed at task-runs.json.pre-v2.backup.
The v2 main file is written only after the recovery backup succeeds.
A conflicting existing backup is never overwritten.
A future top-level schema or future Event version is rejected instead of being interpreted as current data.
An unsupported or unreadable store remains byte-for-byte unchanged after a rejected mutation.

failedAttempt.result: Targeted test process exited with signal 5.
failedAttempt.cause: Foundation Data.write does not support combining atomic and withoutOverwriting.
failedAttempt.correction: Write an atomic unique temporary file in the same directory, then move it without replacing the backup; verify bytes if a concurrent backup appeared.

automatedVerification.macOSBuild: Anchor macOS arm64 Debug build succeeded with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

limitations: An old Anchor binary cannot understand or preserve fields introduced after it shipped; alternating old and new binaries on one data directory is unsupported.
The pre-v2 backup is a migration recovery point, not a continuously updated Event journal.
Lifecycle rows were synthetic privacy-minimal Codex JSONL rather than a live model turn.
No provisioned App Sandbox, iPhone synchronization, multi-hour background run or sleep-wake cycle was tested.
The changes remain uncommitted and have not been pushed, merged, installed, or released.
